text:
omar: anyone heading to the Cup Final on Sat? i have a spare seat (Section 203, Row K) but it's aisle w/ weird view. thinking of swapping for someone with a better timeline

liz: dibs if you can meet at 5:30? :soccer:

kevin: is it the 7pm kickoff? i can do a swap but only if seat is in shade (kids + sunscreen) haha

sasha: also... mini poll: anyone wanna run a 'single-elim bracket' for monday's draft? loser buys tacos. :taco:

nora: i’m in for the bracket. count me. also @omar details on the seat price/transfer?

omar: ticket is e-ticket, i can transfer via TicketFast link. price was $85 but not asking $ — trade + beer works :beer: link: https://ticketfast.example/transfer/abc123

liz: @omar yes meet at lobby of Pub before 5:30? can venmo if needed.

kevin: if liz takes it, i’ll swap my seat instead — Section 109, Row B (center). it's a step up. anyone want to swap 203K for 109B? 1:1 and i bring snacks.

sasha: i'll take 109B if liz grabs omar's seat. anyone volunteer to be bracket ref? need bracket generator link.

nora: i'll run the bracket, gimme 16 names by 9pm. can we make sudden-death (no reseeding)?

omar: sounds good. also, quick logistics: who wants to carpool from mission? i have two seats.

liz: @omar i'll take a spot in carpool.

kevin: thinking of bringing a tiny speaker. will that get me banned? :speaker:

sasha: please no. we have one guy who yells at chants.

nora: poll: tacos or pizza for bracket losers? react with :taco: or :pizza: 

liz: :taco:

kevin: :pizza:

omar: :taco:

sasha: :taco:

nora: ok tacos win. loser buys tacos.

calendar-bot: Event created: 'Cup Final Carpool + Bracket' — Wed 9pm: https://calendar.example/event/456

omar: perfect. @all i'll dm ticket transfer to liz, carpool pickup at 5:10pm mission & 2nd. bracket roster in #random by 9pm. good luck :crossed_fingers:
